questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Project Scope Management, WBS & Agile Project Frameworks
questions.text: Explain ICT Project Management principles. Why do ICT projects fail more often than traditional engineering projects? Describe Project Management Knowledge Areas according to PMBOK guide (Integration, Scope, Time, Cost, Quality, HR, Communications, Risk, Procurement, Stakeholder management).

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Project Scope Management, WBS & Agile Project Frameworks
questions.text: What is a Project Charter? Explain Scope Management and the creation of a Work Breakdown Structure (WBS). Describe WBS Dictionary and the 100% Rule in scope definition.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Cost Estimation for IT Projects & Earned Value Management
questions.text: Explain Function Point Analysis (FPA) for software size estimation. Calculate Unadjusted Function Points (UFP) based on External Inputs (EI), External Outputs (EO), External Inquiries (EQ), Internal Logical Files (ILF), and External Interface Files (EIF) with 14 Value Adjustment Factors (VAF).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: ICT Project Life Cycle, Project Initiation & Stakeholders
questions.text: For a software development project network with 7 activities, draw the network diagram, compute critical path, total float, and free float. Crash the project to determine minimum cost duration.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Cost Estimation for IT Projects & Earned Value Management
questions.text: Explain Earned Value Management (EVM) in ICT projects. A software project has $PV = \$100,000, EV = \$90,000, AC = \$110,000$. Calculate $CV, SV, CPI, SPI$, and Estimate at Completion ($EAC$). Interpret project health.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Quality Management, Risk Assessment & Change Management
questions.text: Explain Risk Management in ICT: Risk Identification, Qualitative Risk Analysis (Probability-Impact Matrix), Quantitative Risk Analysis (Monte Carlo Simulation), and Risk Response Strategies (Avoidance, Mitigation, Transfer, Acceptance).

questions.text: Compare Waterfall vs Agile Project Management. Explain Scrum roles (Product Owner, Scrum Master, Developers), ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective), and artifacts (Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, Burn-Down Charts).
